info.name: ACME Salary Management API
info.description:
Requests and checks for the ACME Salary Management backend.

1. Start the application (default http://localhost:8080).
2. If you changed the HR manager's credentials, update the username and password collection variables.
3. Open the Collection Runner and run the folders in order. Each run creates a new employee with a random code, so it can be repeated.

Most requests carry tests. Requests marked 'expect 4xx' check that the API rejects bad input.

Available Leaves, Leaves and Payments work together: recording a leave reduces its balance, and the next payment deducts pay for balances that went negative. The collection does not exercise the UNPAID-leave double-count edge case.

request.description: Saves the session token in the collection variable {{token}}. Every other request sends it as a bearer token.

exec: // A fresh employee on every run, so the collection can be run again without clashes
pm.test("Returned employee matches the request", function () { pm.expect(json.employeeCode).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get("employeeCode")); });
pm.test("Net salary is gross minus tax and EPF", function () { pm.expect(Number(json.netSalary)).to.eql(73800); });

4. Available Leaves

request.description: This balance is updated and then deleted further down, so it does not affect the payments.

Add a balance without a leave type (expect 400)

exec: pm.test("It is the CASUAL balance with 2 days", function () { pm.expect(json.leaveType).to.eql("CASUAL"); pm.expect(json.availableLeaves).to.eql(2); });

item.name: Get a balance of a type the employee has none of

exec: pm.test("It is the SICK leave balance with 0 days", function () { pm.expect(json.leaveType).to.eql("SICK"); pm.expect(json.availableLeaves).to.eql(0); });

List the balances of the employee

exec: pm.test("Three balances, ordered by leave type", function () { pm.expect(json.map(b => b.leaveType)).to.eql(["CASUAL", "EARNED", "SICK"]); });

Update the EARNED balance to 6 days
Get the EARNED balance after the update
Update EARNED balance without a record ID
Get the EARNED balance after the update

exec: pm.test("A missing balance is created with the requested amount", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().availableLeaves).to.eql(2); });

item.name: Delete a balance of an unknown employee (expect 404)
Delete a balance without a leave type (expect 400)

item.description: Balance starts at CASUAL 2. Every leave recorded in the next folder takes one day off its type's balance, and a balance can go below zero. Recording a payment turns negative balances into deducted pay days and resets them to 0.

item.name: Add CASUAL leave on Wed 14 Jan 2026
Add CASUAL leave on Thu 15 Jan 2026

request.description: CASUAL balance: 0 -> -1, so one day will be deducted from the January payment.

item.name: Add a second leave on the same date (expect 409)

exec: pm.test("Three casual leaves took the balance from 2 to -1", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().availableLeaves).to.eql(-1); });

request.description: The duplicate-date leave above was an EARNED leave. It was refused, so it must not have created a balance.
CASUAL is at -1, so 1 day is deducted. After the salary update the gross is 100000 and the salary net is 83800. January 2026 has 22 weekdays: 100000 / 22 rounds to 4545.45, so 79254.55 is paid.

exec: pm.test("One day is deducted for one negative balance", function () { pm.expect(json.unpaidLeaveDays).to.eql(1); });
pm.test("Leave deduction is 1 day of gross over 22 weekdays", function () { pm.expect(Number(json.leaveDeduction)).to.eql(4545.45); });
pm.test("Net is the salary net minus the deduction", function () { pm.expect(Number(json.netSalary)).to.eql(79254.55); });
pm.test("The negative balance was reset to 0", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().availableLeaves).to.eql(0); });

item.name: Add payment for a month without leave

request.description: The balances were reset by the January payment, so nothing is left over to deduct.

exec: pm.test("No days deducted in February", function () { pm.expect(json.unpaidLeaveDays).to.eql(0); });
pm.test("Net equals the salary net", function () { pm.expect(Number(json.netSalary)).to.eql(83800); });

item.name: Add a leave inside the paid period (expect 409)

request.description: Friday 16 Jan 2026 is a weekday inside the period of the January payment, so the leave is refused.

exec: pm.test("Message explains the lock", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.text()).to.include("already covers"); });

item.name: Add a payment with a period outside the salary range (expect 400)
Download a payslip before it is generated (expect 404)

exec: pm.test("File name is payslip-{id}.pdf", function () { pm.expect(json.fileName).to.eql("payslip-" + pm.collectionVariables.get("paymentId") + ".pdf"); });

request.description: Generates a payslip for every payment that does not have one. Payments that already have one are counted as skipped.
In Postman use Send and Download to save the file, or open the Visualize or Preview tab.

item.name: 8. Cleanup
item.description: Leaves and payments cannot be deleted, so only the balances and the salary are removed and the employee deactivated. Deleting the salary leaves the payments and payslips untouched.
